summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of ME of Ukraine MedTrack application. Backend APIs 90.5% functional (19/21 tests passed). Frontend desktop 95% functional with all major features working. Found 2 critical bugs: (1) Modal overlay blocking clicks, (2) Clipboard permission error on Share button. Mobile version working with proper responsive design and zoom disabled.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 400 when trying to create doctors that already exist (ПЛМ, ОСЛ)
minor_issues.impact: Expected behavior - not a bug, just duplicate prevention

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay intercepts pointer events after opening, preventing clicks on other dashboard cards
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot click on other dashboard cards after opening Revenue modal without closing it first. Must press Escape or click X to close.
ui_bugs.workaround: Press Escape key to close modal before clicking other elements
ui_bugs.reproduction: 1. Open Monthly Services page, 2. Click on 'Наданих послуг' card, 3. Try to click on 'Дохід лікарів' card - click is blocked

ui_bugs.issue: Clipboard write permission denied when clicking Share button
ui_bugs.impact: Share URL is not copied to clipboard, user sees error message
ui_bugs.error: NotAllowedError: Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied
ui_bugs.workaround: Share functionality creates the token successfully, but clipboard copy fails. User needs to manually copy URL from alert/notification
ui_bugs.reproduction: 1. Open Doctor Income modal, 2. Click 'Поділитись' button, 3. Error appears in console

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar visible on mobile (should be hidden)
ui_bugs.impact: Sidebar takes up space on mobile, but mobile navigation at bottom works correctly
ui_bugs.workaround: Mobile navigation at bottom is functional

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix 2 critical bugs: (1) Modal overlay issue - add proper modal close handling or z-index management to prevent blocking clicks on other elements. (2) Clipboard permission error - implement fallback for clipboard.writeText() or show URL in a copyable text field instead of trying to auto-copy. Also fix sidebar visibility on mobile (should be hidden when mobile navigation is active).
